chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Aban, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
"When you intend intercourse, say: 'O God, grant me a child, make him pious and pure, let there be no excess or deficiency in his creation, and make his end good.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication before marital intercourse in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) outlines the spiritual etiquette (adab) of conjugal relations, transforming physical intimacy into an act of worship through intentionality. The supplication emphasizes divine providence for offspring, seeking not only physical perfection but also piety (taqwa) and a righteous end, reflecting the Shia emphasis on nurturing a virtuous generation within the family unit.
